title: MediaAsset
description: A media asset record with provenance and licensing information

asset_id.description: Stable, globally unique identifier for this asset.

exercise_id.description: The exercise this asset belongs to.

file_path.description: Relative path to the asset file from the repository root.

resolution.description: Pixel dimensions. Not applicable to SVG (use null).

creator.description: Name of the person or organization who created the asset.

source.description: Where the asset was obtained from, if not created originally for OEI.

license.description: SPDX license identifier or a recognized license name, e.g. 'CC0-1.0', 'CC-BY-4.0', 'MIT'.

attribution.description: Required attribution text, if any. Empty string if no attribution is required (CC0).

commercial_usage_allowed.description: Whether the license permits commercial use.

provenance_url.description: URL to the original source of the asset or its license page.

approval_status.description: Whether a maintainer has verified the licensing information.

approved_by.description: GitHub username of the maintainer who approved this asset.

notes.description: Any additional notes about the asset, its license, or required handling.
